newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George calls for lower rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George calls for lower rates.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd chairman Frank Conroy said on Wednesday that he would advocate a further cut in interest rates by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).
"Certainly a reduction in rates would act as a partial stimulant to the economy and it may be well deserved," Conroy told reporters after the bank's annual meeting.

Asked if he would advocate a cut Conroy replied: "I think on balance I would." There was considerable speculation in financial markets today that the RBA would announce a rate cut in current 6.0 percent official interest rates.
The RBA last cut rates by 0.5 percentage point on December 11, 1996.
Conroy said the Australian economy was growing quite well, but was fragmented from sector to sector.
"There is no doubt, at least over the immediate period that it may be possible for the Reserve Bank to reduce rates," Conroy said.
